snippet.title: Underground Blossom - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
📣 Next stop in the Rusty Lake universe: Underground Blossom! 🚇 🌸

We’re happy to finally share a first look at our upcoming project, Underground Blossom! Descend into the Rusty Lake Underground and travel through the life and memories of Laura Vanderboom! 

All aboard the Underground Blossom Demo - now available to play on mobile and PC! 
🍎 https://apps.apple.com/app/id6449941256 
🤖 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.RustyLake.UndergroundBlossomLite 
The demo is also available on ⚙️ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2291850/Underground_Blossom/ and itchio: https://rustylake.itch.io/underground-blossom

Don’t forget to wishlist Underground Blossom to secure a ticket! 🎟️
🍎 https://apps.apple.com/app/id1665706687 
🤖 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.RustyLake.UndergroundBlossom 

The full premium experience is expecting to arrive on September 27th, 2023. 📍 📅  on mobile (iOS / Android) and PC! 🛤️ 

This announcement kickstarts our 8-year anniversary celebration week, so please stay tuned for more exciting news! 🎂🎉

Read more about our anniversary week and Underground Blossom on our blog! 📰  https://blog.rustylake.com/underground-blossom-rusty-lakes-8-years-anniversary

🎼 Music by Victor Butzelaar
🎥 Trailer & Voice acting by Bob Rafferty

#UndergroundBlossom #rustylake
